load_path: Head shell and thick lower flange
Two structural plinth halves with upper and root diaphragms
4 mm aluminum saddle and four metal spacers
Four M4 through-bolts and integral side-rail ears
assembly_sequence: Attach saddle and spacers to the modified rails.
Attach plinth halves with the head absent, lay in wiring, and close the seam.
Attach the head from inside the open enclosure, then fit sensors and lid.
fall_limitations: Head-first impacts can involve whole-robot inertia.
The top-mounted lidar remains exposed in an inverted fall.
Elastomer bumper is not a certified energy absorber.
manufacturing_note: Plinth halves print on their center split planes. Saddle is a flat 4 mm metal plate. Rail ears require revised rails; they are not supported by the removable body shell.
